definitions.explanation: The physical or mental effort required to accomplish a task, or the human resources needed for work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{労力|ろうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes a great deal of effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{労力|ろうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This task requires a lot of manpower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧な{労力|ろうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省|はぶ}いて→省く：02398_habuku⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{進|すす}めたい→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to cut out unnecessary effort and proceed efficiently.

notes:
Refers to the effort or work put into accomplishing something, encompassing both physical labor and mental exertion. Often used when discussing whether a task is worth the time and energy invested.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {労力|ろうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put in effort
- {労力|ろうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{費|つい}やす→費やす：10424_tsuiyasu⟧: to expend effort
- {労力|ろうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省|はぶ}く→省く：02398_habuku⟧: to save effort
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧な{労力|ろうりょく}: wasted effort
- ⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧な{労力|ろうりょく}: enormous effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: effort — emphasizes personal determination and trying hard, while {労力|ろうりょく} focuses on the amount of work or resources required
- ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧: time and trouble — focuses on the practical inconvenience or steps involved, often used for smaller tasks
